mustReport.detail: Sender-side ACK during the zero-window stall (no 1-byte probe payload). tshark 4.6 labels frame index 5 as 'TCP Dup ACK'; either classification is acceptable, but it must NOT be reported as packet loss.

notes: Cause must be 'likely': receiving application not draining its socket buffer. Never assert a specific application.
description: Receiver advertises window 0 for ~1.3 s, sender probes, window finally re-opens.
